name: jarvis-macos
description: JARVIS desktop assistant for macOS — floating orb UI
author: Yogesh Kumar

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,magenta "vite" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.smoke: vite build && cross-env JARVIS_MOCK_ENGINE=1 JARVIS_SMOKE=1 electron .
scripts.dist: npm run icon && vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:arm64: npm run icon && vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:x64: npm run icon && vite build && electron-builder --mac --x64
scripts.check: node --check electron/main.js && node --check electron/preload.js && node --check electron/engine.js && node --check electron/tray.js && node --check electron/windowState.js && node --check electron/permissions.js

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Jarvis listens for "Hey Jarvis" and your voice commands. Audio is only sent for transcription after the wake word or when you press the talk shortcut.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Jarvis controls apps like Finder, Music, Notes, Reminders, Calendar and Messages when you ask it to.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Jarvis looks at your screen only when you ask things like "what's this error on my screen?"
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Jarvis reads and adds calendar events when you ask.
extendInfo.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Jarvis adds to-dos to Reminders when you ask.
